summary: Documents a long-standing technique, supported by many mail servers, that tells users when new mail arrives. The server sends a short notification string to a client, which can alert the user or a mail client. It is informational.

eli5.summary: The mailman rings your doorbell to say a letter arrived, instead of you walking to check the mailbox. This memo describes that simple doorbell for email.

questions: how do mail servers notify of new mail
